title: Fully Guided Neural Schrödinger Bridge for Brain MR Image Synthesis
tldr_zh: UNSB 改配对：源图全程条件 + L1/patchNCE/互信息正则 + 病灶 mask 加权损失，NFE=5，作者报告 5 个脑 MRI 数据集像素与 WMH Dice 多为最优
tldr_en: Paired UNSB variant with full source guidance, MI regularizer and lesion-mask weighted losses; NFE=5; authors report best PSNR and WMH segmentation Dice on most of five brain MRI datasets.
key_numbers: MICCAI2017 WMH T1w->FLAIR: PSNR 27.39 / SSIM 0.928 / WMH Dice 0.381 / Recall 0.386 vs I2I-Mamba 25.38 / 0.909 / 0.315 / 0.274; real FLAIR upper bound Dice 0.679 (Table 2)
CAVAS: I2I-Mamba better PSNR (26.04 vs 25.95) but worse Dice (0.312 vs 0.421) and Recall (0.499 vs 0.669) (Table 2)
VALDO T1w->T2*: PSNR 28.11 vs Pix2Pix/I2I-Mamba 26.89 (Table 2); CMBs not reconstructed by any method (Sec. 5.2)
Ablation: lesion losses add +0.082 Dice but only +0.23 dB PSNR (Table 4)
Training subjects: IXI 25, BraTS 15, MICCAI2017 10, VALDO 19, CAVAS 10 (Sec. 4.1)
